name: cell division cycle 42

function.text: CDC42 encodes cell division control protein 42 homolog. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in signal transduction and endocytosis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Takenouchi-Kosaki syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
